title: Windows Error Reporting
description: WER captures user-mode dumps and can upload them to Microsoft’s Watson pipeline. It captures user/kernel crashes as minidump (.dmp); the pipeline is Watson buckets.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Linux core dumps
description: The kernel writes ELF core files on fatal signals; coredumpctl manages them under systemd. It captures fatal signals as ELF core / lz4 journal; the pipeline is coredumpctl + gdb.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: macOS crash reports
description: CrashReporter writes .ips files with thread states to ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports. It captures app/hang crashes as .ips JSON; the pipeline is Xcode Organizer.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Android tombstones
description: debuggerd writes tombstones with registers and backtraces to /data/tombstones. It captures native crashes as tombstone text; the pipeline is Play Console / Firebase.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Breakpad
description: Google’s cross-platform crash library generating minidumps with a symbol server pipeline. It captures C++ crashes as minidump; the pipeline is Socorro/symbol server.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Crashpad
description: Breakpad’s successor with out-of-process dump generation used by Chrome and Electron. It captures crashes + hangs as minidump; the pipeline is Crashpad server.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Sentry
description: Sentry’s SDKs capture exceptions with breadcrumbs, releases, and suspect-commit mapping. It captures exceptions + native as Sentry envelope; the pipeline is Sentry issues.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Apport
description: Ubuntu’s crash interceptor filing Launchpad bugs with retraced stack traces. It captures app crashes as .crash files; the pipeline is Launchpad + retracer.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: kdump
description: kdump boots a capture kernel on panic to save vmcore for post-mortem analysis. It captures kernel panics as vmcore (ELF); the pipeline is crash utility.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Dr. Watson
description: The classic Windows 9x/XP debugger logging crashes before WER replaced it. It captures app faults as drwtsn32.log; the pipeline is local log review.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Minidump format
description: Microsoft’s compact dump standard: threads, stacks, and modules without full memory. It captures portable snapshots as .dmp streams; the pipeline is any minidump reader.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Firebase Crashlytics
description: Real-time crash reporting for mobile with velocity alerts and custom keys. It captures mobile crashes as Crashlytics payload; the pipeline is Firebase console.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Backtrace.io
description: Coroner-style dump analysis with classifiers grouping crashes by root cause. It captures native/web crashes as minidump + objects; the pipeline is Backtrace coroner.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: ABRT
description: Fedora’s Automatic Bug Reporting Tool catching C, Python, and Java crashes alike. It captures multi-language as problem dirs; the pipeline is Bugzilla filing.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Nintendo? no — QNX slog2
description: QNX’s slog2 captures structured crash data on real-time embedded targets. It captures RTOS faults as slog2 buffers; the pipeline is Momentics IDE.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
